Title: Diagnosis of test `testReflectionLongArrayArray`

Details: 
The failing test `testReflectionLongArrayArray` creates a 2-dimensional array of type `long[][]` with some null inner arrays. It then calls the method `toBaseString` from the same test class, which simply returns a string containing the class name and hash code of the object. The test method subsequently nullifies the array and calls `validateNullToStringStyleRegistry`.

The key to the failure probably lies in the use of the `ReflectionToStringBuilder.toString` methods when dealing with multi-dimensional primitive arrays containing null elements or when outputting such arrays in string form. The main code flow from `ToStringBuilder.reflectionToString(Object)` delegates to `ReflectionToStringBuilder.toString(Object)` which in turn calls a more specific overload with options, ultimately creating an instance of `ReflectionToStringBuilder` and calling its `toString()`.

The method `toBaseString` used in the test only formats the class name and identity hash code, so likely the failure is related to handling the array in the `ReflectionToStringBuilder.toString()` string generation process, not in `toBaseString`.

The suspect is that when reflecting on the `long[][]` array containing null arrays, `ReflectionToStringBuilder` does not correctly handle or represent nested null arrays or multi-dimensional primitives arrays, leading to an incorrect or unexpected string output, causing the test to fail.

The issue is likely in `ReflectionToStringBuilder` specifically where it builds the string for array fields with recursive reflection and neutral handling of nulls.

Recommended methods to investigate and fix:
- `org.apache.commons.lang3.builder.ReflectionToStringBuilder.toString(java.lang.Object)`
- `org.apache.commons.lang3.builder.ReflectionToStringBuilder.toString(Object, ToStringStyle, boolean, boolean, Class<?>)`
- `org.apache.commons.lang3.builder.ReflectionToStringBuilder.<constructor>`
- `org.apache.commons.lang3.builder.ReflectionToStringBuilder.toString()` (instance method)

Based on the available information, provide the signatures of the most likely culprit methods for the bug. Your answer will be processed automatically, so make sure to only answer with the accurate signatures of all likely culprits (in `ClassName.MethodName(ArgType1, ArgType2, ...)` format), without commentary (one per line).

ReflectionToStringBuilder.toString(Object)
ReflectionToStringBuilder.toString(Object, ToStringStyle, boolean, boolean, Class)
ReflectionToStringBuilder.toString()
ReflectionToStringBuilder.ReflectionToStringBuilder(Object, ToStringStyle, StringBuffer, Class, boolean, boolean)
